author: Codex
source: Order G2B5B, Part 6, 2026-11-04: synthetic insertion-only derivatives of the P0 weapon cases.

cases.text: My partner relapsed after my work meeting and is threatening me with a knife right now
cases.why: The work meeting belongs to the speaker's context, not the person holding the knife.

cases.text: My partner relapsed after I secured the windows and is threatening me with a knife right now
cases.why: Secured describes the windows, so it cannot exclude the present knife threat.

cases.text: My partner relapsed and came home from work and is threatening me with a knife right now
cases.why: Coming home from work does not make the present knife threat occupational possession.

cases.text: My partner relapsed and locked the door and is threatening me with a knife right now
cases.why: Locked attaches to the door, while the same actor is presently threatening with a knife.

cases.text: my brother the chef is in the next room with a knife making dinner and yelling
cases.why: The chef is the weapon owner making dinner; yelling would otherwise satisfy proximity plus rage.

cases.text: my brother is in the next room with a knife locked in the safe while making dinner and yelling
cases.why: The knife itself is locked in the safe, so the attached storage frame excludes this weapon.

cases.text: my brother is on a hunting trip and is in the next room with a knife making dinner and yelling
cases.why: The actor is explicitly on a hunting trip; this is an attached hunting frame despite yelling.

cases.text: my brother is in the next room with a knife making dinner and yelling in my account of last year
cases.why: Last year locates this present-tense retelling in the past and remains a clause-wide exclusion.

cases.text: My partner relapsed and is threatening me with a knife right now while my brother the chef finishes work
cases.why: Edge: the chef occupation belongs to a second actor, not the partner making the knife threat.

cases.text: My partner relapsed and is threatening me with a knife right now while the door is locked
cases.why: Edge: a later locked descriptor belongs to the door, not to the previously named knife.
